key.name: panel-transparency
key.description: Make the top panel transparent.

key.name: panel-transparency-level
key.description: Set the transparency level of the panel (0-100).

key.name: panel-opaque-on-window
key.description: Make panel opaque when a window touches it.

key.name: panel-blur
key.description: Apply a blur effect behind the top panel when it is transparent.

key.name: panel-color-inherit
key.description: Apply background-color: inherit to fix panel color issues on some themes (e.g., white panel on dark themes).

key.name: panel-invert-tray-icons
key.summary: Invert Tray Icons on Light Wallpapers
key.description: Darken white monochrome tray icons when the panel adapts to a light wallpaper. Colored icons are left untouched.

key.name: show-window-title
key.description: Display the current window title in the top panel.

key.name: show-window-title-icon
key.summary: Show app icon next to the window title
key.description: Display the focused application's icon next to the window title in the top panel.

key.name: show-tiling-title-menu
key.summary: Add Tiling Layouts to the Window Title Menu
key.description: Add window tiling layouts to the menu opened from the window title in the panel. Available for any focused window, including windows that are not maximized.

key.name: panel-hover-fullscreen
key.summary: Show Panel on Hover in Fullscreen
key.description: Show the top panel when hovering near the top edge in fullscreen mode.

key.name: move-calendar-right
key.description: Move the calendar to the right side of the top panel and hide the notifications panel.

key.name: keep-notification-panel
key.description: When Move Calendar to Right is enabled, keep the native notification/calendar combined layout (only the panel position changes).

key.name: notification-indicator-style
key.description: Color style of the top-panel notification indicator dot: default (red), accent (follows accent color), or symbolic (theme foreground).

key.name: battery-percentage
key.description: Enable or disable showing battery percentage.

key.name: lock-icon
key.description: Enable or disable the lock icon.

key.name: custom-dnd-button
key.description: Replace the system Do Not Disturb quick settings button with Kiwi's custom implementation.

key.name: hide-media-player
key.description: Hide the Media Player from Quick Settings

key.name: hide-media-indicator
key.description: Hide the Media Status indicator in the quick menu while media is playing

key.name: hide-activities-button
key.description: Hide the Activities button in the top panel.

key.name: add-username-to-quick-menu
key.description: Enable or disable adding the username to the quick menu.

key.name: panel-styling
key.description: Restyle the top panel: tighter button spacing, bold titles, smaller status icons, no dropdown arrows and a transparent panel in the overview.

key.name: popup-menu-styling
key.description: Restyle shell popup menus with taller items and accent-colored hover, selected and checked entries, and apply the GTK 3 and GTK 4 app fixes (fixes3.css, fixes4.css).

key.name: keyboard-indicator
key.description: Enable additional options for the panel keyboard/input source indicator.

key.name: hide-keyboard-indicator
key.description: Completely hide the keyboard/input source indicator from the panel.

key.name: minimize-to-dock
key.description: Park minimized windows as thumbnails in Dash-to-Dock, after the apps and before the trash.

key.name: downloads-in-dock
key.description: Add a Downloads folder to Dash-to-Dock, before the trash, that fans its newest files out over the desktop when clicked.

key.name: downloads-behind-folder
key.description: Draw the newest files behind the Downloads folder icon, sticking out of its top, rather than piled on top of it.

key.name: enable-launchpad-app
key.description: Adds a custom Launchpad icon to dock that opens the application overview.

key.name: launchpad-app-custom-icon
key.description: Path to a custom icon for the Launchpad application. Supports PNG and SVG formats, max 512x512 pixels. Empty string uses the default icon.

key.name: dock-styling
key.description: Tighten Dash-to-Dock icon spacing and remove the icon hover highlight.

key.name: dock-blur
key.description: Apply a blur effect behind the Dash-to-Dock background.

key.name: dock-adaptive-colors
key.description: Flip the Dash-to-Dock running indicators and separators between light and dark to suit whatever is behind the dock, wallpaper or window. Writes Dash-to-Dock's own colour settings and puts them back when switched off.

key.name: enable-app-window-buttons
key.description: Enable or disable window control buttons in application windows (affects GTK theming).

key.name: button-type
key.description: Determines which set of icons to use for window control buttons.

key.name: button-size
key.description: Determines the size of window control buttons (small: 14px, normal: 16px).

key.name: enable-firefox-styling
key.description: Manage Firefox userChrome.css to apply Kiwi window controls styling and hide Firefox window buttons when panel controls are shown.

key.name: enable-thunderbird-styling
key.description: Manage Thunderbird userChrome.css to apply Kiwi window controls styling and hide Thunderbird window buttons when panel controls are shown.

key.name: show-window-controls
key.description: Display window control buttons in the top panel when window is maximized.

key.name: show-window-controls-fullscreen-only
key.summary: Show Window Controls on Panel only when Fullscreen
key.description: When enabled, panel window controls and titlebar hiding apply only to fullscreen windows, not maximized.

key.name: overview-wallpaper-background
key.description: Use the current desktop wallpaper as a blurred background in the overview.

key.name: skip-overview-on-login
key.description: Do not show the overview when logging into GNOME. Still shows animation.

key.name: hide-minimized-windows
key.description: Hide minimized windows in the overview.

key.name: move-window-to-new-workspace
key.description: Enable or disable moving windows to new workspaces.

key.name: reduce-window-animations
key.description: Replace the default window opening and closing animation with a subtle macOS-style scale and fade.

key.name: transparent-move
key.description: Enable or disable transparent move.
